blocks.title: Tanqeedi soch
blocks.text: Critical thinking ka matlab maloomat par sawal uthana, mukhtalif nuqta-e-nazar dekhna aur soch samajh kar faisla karna hai.
Nayi technology ke baare mein parhein to raye banane se pehle kai maakhaz aur nuqta-e-nazar dekhein.

blocks.prompt: Critical thinking maloomat ke zimmedarana istemal mein kaise madad deti hai, asal misalon ke saath (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Critical thinking hamein yaqeen ya share karne se pehle poochne par aamada karti hai ke kaun keh raha hai, kya saboot hai aur doosre kya kehte hain. Misalein: viral paigham daawa kare ke gharelu nuskha bimari theek karta hai, to aage bhejne se pehle sehat ke idare aur doctors se jaanchein; review site sirf ek brand ki tareef kare, to azad reviews milayein; khabar ki surkhi chaunka dene wali ho, to poora mazmoon parh kar doosre idaron se jaanchein. Is se ghalat maloomat nahi phailti aur behtar faisle hote hain.

items: Critical thinking: sawal karo, nuqta-e-nazar milao, phir faisla karo.
